The LAST attached image is a layout guide: a pure magenta (#FF00FF) field with a thin grid and a 1 x 1 box outlined in the middle, one board tile. Draw the SUBJECT alone, standing on the ground inside that box and filling it well (it may rise above the box, never past the box's sides), SQUARE-ON, with a soft contact shadow directly under it, and leave every other pixel pure magenta: no grass, no ground, no grid lines over the subject, no vignette. No letters anywhere, no animals.
